metadata.refit_randomness: Model RNG streams held fixed across repetitions; resampled training images vary.

q2_case_evidence.pairwise_disagreement: Fraction of unordered bagging-tree pairs disagreeing on this face.
q2_case_evidence.tree_change_fraction: Fraction changing predicted class when the central block is masked.
q2_case_evidence.boosting_change_fraction: Sum of alpha for changed weak learners divided by total alpha.
q2_case_evidence.weighted_votes: Raw sums of alpha by predicted class; divide by boosting_total_alpha for confidence.
q2_case_evidence.central_region_importance: Global training-set impurity importance summed over rows/columns 24:40; bagging mean or alpha-weighted boosting mean. Descriptive, not causal.

q2.selection_rule: One ensemble changes class under masking while the other does not.
